value.question: What is a follow-up visit?
plan: A follow-up visit is a scheduled check-in after treatment.
It monitors patient recovery and health status.
It ensures long-term safety and treatment effectiveness.

value.draft: A follow-up visit is a scheduled check-in after treatment to monitor the patient's recovery and health status. These visits help ensure long-term safety and assess how well the treatment is working. They allow healthcare providers to address any concerns, track progress, and make necessary adjustments to care. Follow-up visits are an important part of the treatment process, supporting both the patient's well-being and the success of the clinical trial.
